title: A thoughtful path forward.
intro: A clear view of what is available today and what remains experimental. Future work has no promised release dates.

sections.title: Available — The core language
sections.body: Typed state, component composition, keyed lists, shared state, child events and lifecycle hooks are included in the published 1.0.1 package.

sections.title: Available — The development workflow
sections.body: The compiler, located diagnostics, CLI checks and Vite integration support local development. This website itself is built with Qbits components and the published package.

sections.title: Experimental — Client-side routing
sections.body: Static routes, parameters and fallback routes are documented and tested in Qbits. The routing API is experimental and can change outside the stable API guarantee.

sections.title: Looking ahead — Broader capabilities
sections.body: Server rendering, nested routing, route guards and editor tooling are currently unsupported. Follow the project on GitHub for proposals and release notes.
